about: iptables-legacy-save snapshots, parsed as firewall() returns them, of what older guest scripts installed: cfbde9f is the last script before decision 24, 891fc47 the one on main; 'ipv6 block' is test_kernel.comprehensive_plan(), 'ipv6 managed' that plan with ipv6 guest 2001:db8:1::2 and ingress [fe80::1%2]:43771. Generated once by running each script's own install_rules against a simulated iptables that already held the 'foreign' rules, so the instance rules come from those scripts and not from kernel.legacy_rules.
